tasks.name: Open operations dashboard
tasks.entry_state: frontend loaded, backend reachable or reconnecting
tasks.exit_state: venue map, status strip, and initial stream state are visible
happy_path: Render first snapshot or skeleton state
failure_modes: Backend unavailable: show reconnecting status and preserve layout
Snapshot empty: show venue shell with zero-density state
WebSocket blocked: continue polling snapshot endpoint if implemented

tasks.name: Run deterministic replay
tasks.entry_state: dashboard connected and replay scenarios loaded
tasks.exit_state: selected scenario streams events at chosen speed
happy_path: Watch heatmap, flow vectors, alerts, and timeline update
failure_modes: Scenario missing: show scenario error with fallback to mock
Replay end: pause at final frame with restart action
Invalid speed: clamp to supported range

tasks.name: Inspect congestion alert
tasks.entry_state: at least one active alert exists
tasks.exit_state: alert details and map focus are visible
happy_path: Details show severity, duration, source mode, and supporting sensors
failure_modes: Alert resolved during inspection: mark resolved and keep details readable
Zone missing: show alert without map focus and log schema mismatch

tasks.name: Inspect sensor overlay
tasks.entry_state: sensor nodes are present in snapshot
tasks.exit_state: node health, latency, mode, and mesh links are visible
happy_path: Switch to topology panel for mesh links
failure_modes: No sensors: show empty overlay state
Offline sensor: keep node visible with offline status
Mesh unavailable: hide links and explain adapter-disabled state

tasks.name: Switch data mode
tasks.exit_state: mode changes or rejects with clear reason
happy_path: UI updates provenance badge and stream
failure_modes: Live adapter unavailable: disabled option shows reason
Mode switch fails: keep previous mode and show error
